class.name: NNHTNCondition
class.brief_description: Boolean [Expression] resource used for HTN preconditions, postconditions, and binding filters.
class.description: Add to [member NNHTNNodes.conditions], [member NNHTNTask.postconditions], or [member NNHTNBinding.conditions] to express data-driven checks over the blackboard and task [code]args[/code] without writing scripts. Referenced blackboard keys are detected automatically so changes to them trigger replanning. [codeblock] is_scared and not is_tired health < args.get("limit", 25) [/codeblock]

method.name: evaluate
method.description: Evaluates [member expression] against [param state] keys and [param args]. Returns [code]false[/code] on parse/execution errors or non-boolean results.

method.name: get_parse_error
method.description: Returns the parse error message for [member expression], or an empty string if valid.

method.name: get_read_keys
method.description: Returns the blackboard keys referenced by [member expression], in order of first use.

members.member: Boolean Godot [Expression] referencing blackboard keys as variables and [code]args[/code] as the task's arguments dictionary. Missing keys evaluate as [code]null[/code].
